I was alone and got a slightly unattractive seat.

text: While the Imperial Citadel shows you the sheer scale of the empire, this museum shows you its soul. Housed inside the gorgeous Long An Palace, the atmosphere here is slow and contemplative, scented with aged timber and filled with quiet history. title: MANVAR Rasoi Indian Restaurant
text:
🇮🇳❤️ Missing the taste of home while living in Da Nang? This is the place you need to try!

I’ve been living in Da Nang for around three and a half months, and finding Indian food that truly tastes like home hasn’t been easy. I’ve tried several places in this city, but honestly, this restaurant has won my heart! The food is absolutely delicious, and what makes it even more special is that they prepare dishes in authentic Andhra style while also offering North Indian flavours.

Whether you’re craving spicy Andhra food, North Indian dishes, masala dosa, plain dosa, or egg dosa, they bring those familiar flavours that make you feel like you’re back home in India. 🏡

And it’s not just about the food — the owner and the entire team are incredibly kind especially MANU ,welcoming, and attentive. They genuinely care about their customers and serve food with so much love that it feels like a home-cooked meal.

Another big plus: they offer home delivery! 🛵 You can contact them directly through their phone number to place an order and enjoy delicious Indian food in the comfort of your home.

As an Indian living abroad, I sometimes miss the food and flavours I grew up with, and this restaurant has filled that gap beautifully. It’s more than just a place to eat; it’s a little taste of home in Da Nang. ❤️

If you’re an Indian living in Da Nang or a foreigner looking to explore authentic Indian cuisine, I highly recommend giving this place a try. You won’t regret it!

Thank you to the owner and the whole team for serving such amazing food and making us feel at home, even when we’re far away from it. Keep up the fantastic work! 🙏🇮🇳

textTranslated:
They charged taxes twice without informing us before ordering. It only came on the bill and was not reflected in the price of the dish. We are tourists and do not have to pay taxes. We said this but they refused to reduce the tax payment. After negotiation we were forced to pay.
In addition, the prices of the dishes are very expensive compared to other places. Not worth the price.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ms. Peretz,

VAT or Value Added Tax is a pass-through tax that businesses collect on behalf of the Vietnamese government, regardless of your nationality.

Our menu clearly informs about that on every page. Our online menu also states that clearly.

We are required to charge a VAT of 8% on food and 10% on alcohol, hence 2 lines of tax at the end of the bill, we do not charge tax twice on any item.

We understand that you are tourists and probably are not aware of Vietnamese laws. We are a legally incorporated and we issue invoices for all customers.

We do not hide revenue by not issuing invoices for tables that pay by cash like you suggested.

We were willing to call the police to come as you requested but then you refused to wait for them.

With respect, we understand your frustration when in a new country, and we hope to receive your understanding and acknowledgement when we work and abide to our national laws.

Kind regards,
RTR

title: Riverside Terrace Restaurant
text:
Hemos ido a cenar y ha sido una de las mejores experiencias gastronómicas de nuestro viaje por Filipinas y Vietnam. Todo estaba buenísimo y desde el primer momento nos atendieron genial, además de colocarnos en una mesa en un sitio perfecto.

La chica que nos atendió fue súper amable y nos dio un montón de recomendaciones locales. Ella es de la zona de Hué y nos recomendó sitios y lugares que visitar, algo que se agradece muchísimo cuando estás viajando.

Las pizzas estaban increíbles. Yo siempre pido margarita porque creo que es la mejor forma de saber si una pizzería es buena, y estaba realmente buenísima. Mi pareja pidió la carbonara y también estaba espectacular.

Para terminar, pedimos un tiramisú casero y un affogato, ambos muy buenos. El tiramisú, además, se notaba que era casero de verdad.

El vino que nos recomendaron también fue un acierto. En resumen, comida muy buena, servicio excelente y un trato cercano. Sin duda, uno de los sitios que más nos han gustado de todo el viaje.
textTranslated:
We went for dinner and it was one of the best culinary experiences of our trip through the Philippines and Vietnam. Everything was delicious, and from the moment we arrived, the service was fantastic, and they seated us at a table in a perfect spot.

The waitress who served us was incredibly friendly and gave us tons of local recommendations. She's from the Hue area and recommended places to visit, which is so appreciated when you're traveling.

The pizzas were amazing. I always order a Margherita because I think it's the best way to tell if a pizzeria is good, and it was truly delicious. My partner ordered the Carbonara, and it was also spectacular.

To finish, we ordered homemade tiramisu and an affogato, both very good. The tiramisu, in particular, tasted like it was truly homemade.

The wine they recommended was also a great choice. In short, very good food, excellent service, and a friendly atmosphere. Without a doubt, one of our favorite places on the entire trip.

Riverside Terrace Restaurant offers a beautiful location right next to the river, making it a perfect spot to spend a lovely family dinner.
The service is incredibly welcoming. A very kind employee took the time to chat with us, explaining that while the owner is Canadian, they definitely know exactly how to cook great Italian food!
We started with the antipasti, which was okay and came with a really delicious spicy local oil. My only slight critique as a French person is that there wasn't quite enough bread served with it! For our mains, both the pizza Meatlover and the meatloaf were good and paired nicely with some cold Saigon Premium and Tiger beers. We also ordered french fries and a Margherita pizza to take away for our kid, and they were a big hit.
Overall, a great, relaxing experience with kind staff and a wonderful riverside atmosphere.

title: Vấn Cocktail Bar
text:
Ich bin zwei mal zu der Bar. Das erste Mal um 01:30 Uhr, also eine halbe Stunde vor Ladenschluss. Kam mit jemand entgegen und meinte, ne heute sind wir schon zu. Okay, kein Problem, wahrscheinlich langsamer Tag, aber trotzdem komisch früher zu schließen.

Beim zweiten Mal habe ich extra eine Route mit Bars geplant, so dass ich überall genügend zeit haben sollte. Komme ich hier um 00:30 Uhr an, Bar ist noch offen, ich gehe rein. Kommt der Kellner auf mich zu und meint sie wären schon geschlossen und hätten seit 50 Minuten den Service eingestellt. 50 Minuten? Um 00:30 Uhr, also um 23:40 Uhr, obwohl die Bar eine Öffnungszeit bis 02:00 Uhr angibt.
Ich finde das unverschämt, ändert eure Öffnungszeiten oder bleibt offen, aber das kann ich nicht nachvollziehen. Mir wurde dann sogar gesagt, dass ich doch am nächsten Tag es mal um 22:00 Uhr probieren soll… Da blieben mir die Worte aus. War mein letzter Tag in Da Nang und 2 von 3 Bars haben deutlich vor ihrer eigentlichen Schließzeit dicht gemacht. Und die dritte hat nach meinem Besuch geschlossen, auch ne halbe Stunde vor regulärem Ladenschluss.
textTranslated:
I went to the bar twice. The first time was at 1:30 a.m., half an hour before closing time. Someone came towards me and said, "Nope, we're already closed today." Okay, no problem, probably just a slow day, but still, it's strange to close early.

The second time, I specifically planned a route with bars so I'd have plenty of time at each one. I arrived at 12:30 a.m., the bar was still open, and I went in. The waiter came up to me and said they were already closed and had stopped serving 50 minutes ago. 50 minutes? At 12:30 a.m., which is 11:40 p.m., even though the bar advertises closing time until 2:00 a.m.

I find that outrageous. Change your opening hours or stay open, but I just can't understand it. I was even told to try again the next day at 10:00 p.m.... I was speechless. It was my last day in Da Nang and two out of three bars closed well before their scheduled closing time. The third closed after I left, also half an hour before its regular closing time.
responseFromOwnerText: Hello Dennis, thank you for sharing your feedback, though we really concerned to hear it as it doesn't match our usuals standards. There seems to be a misunderstanding, as our last order is at 1:30am and closes at 2am. Looking back at our logs and camera footage from recent days, we were opening fully within our normal hours and serving guests well past midnight. So please feel free to message us directly through gmail ourteam180@gmail.com so we can clarify it together. Thank you 🤍
address: 17 Trần Bạch Đằng, An Hải, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam

title: Pilgrimage Village resort & spa
text:
My wife, daughter and I spent two wonderful nights at Pilgrimage Village Resort, and it was undoubtedly one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

After the busy streets of Hanoi and Da Nang, and before heading to the lively chaos of Saigon, this place was exactly what we needed. A true oasis of peace and relaxation.

The resort is simply stunning. The lush gardens, beautiful flowers, swimming pools and every little corner of the outdoor areas create an incredible atmosphere of calm and beauty. Just walking around the property is a pleasure.

Our villa was exceptional. Spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, spacious and extremely comfortable. Even the smallest details had been considered, including mosquito treatment in the room to ensure a peaceful night's sleep. And the bathroom? Absolutely enormous! Beautifully designed, incredibly well equipped and finished with exceptional taste and attention to detail.

Breakfast was another highlight. An amazing selection of fresh, high-quality food, with pretty much everything you could wish for.

The staff deserve special recognition. Everyone was incredibly friendly, attentive and professional, always available when needed but never intrusive. That perfect balance of hospitality that makes you feel truly welcome.

And I cannot finish this review without mentioning two experiences that made our stay even more special.

First, the massages! We received 30 minutes of complimentary massage for each night of our stay, meaning a full hour per person over our two nights. The lady who treated me was absolutely fantastic. Without exaggeration, one of the best massages I have ever had!

Second, the 7 AM beginner's Tai Chi session. What a wonderful way to start the day! Practising Tai Chi surrounded by such beautiful and peaceful surroundings was an experience I genuinely believe everyone should try at least once.

Pilgrimage Village is much more than just a hotel. It is a place where you can slow down, disconnect from the outside world and simply enjoy being there.

Would I return? Without the slightest hesitation. And next time, I would definitely stay longer!

Thank you to the entire team for making our family stay so memorable.

We were also particularly grateful for the assistance we received after accidentally leaving an item behind in our room. The hotel team responded promptly and handled the situation with great care and efficiency. Overall, Moire Hoi An delivered an excellent combination of atmosphere, dining and service. The staff deserve particular recognition for their warmth, professionalism and thoughtful hospitality.

Driver Michael provided a great transfer in a luxury Mercedes SUV, and Mimy at the Yellow Bicycle restaurant was exceptionally warm and welcoming, they were truly the only two staff members we genuinely liked and appreciated during our stay.

Regrettably, the hotel struggled with basic housekeeping, communication, service anticipation, and hospitality grace.

Although modern, our room was noticeably dirty in several spots (see attached picture), and throughout our two-night stay, dirty dishes were left uncollected in the hallway corridor for the entire duration of our visit.

Upon landing in Danang, being exhausted, we inadvertently forgot about our booked transfer and arranged a Grab; however, for a 5-star luxury hotel that had our flight number and WhatsApp contact, we expected a proactive call or heads-up upon landing rather than a message two hours later while we were already en route. Although we profusely apologized via chat and willingly paid for the transfer anyway, the lobby and check-in staff repeatedly brought up and dwelled on how long the driver had been waiting, making us feel unnecessarily guilty throughout the check-in process.

Furthermore, during a sudden rainstorm at the pool, staff ran for shelter holding umbrellas over themselves without offering assistance or umbrellas to guests trying to cover their belongings (see attached picture).

Lastly, the breakfast setup requires guests to walk to a booth just to order eggs that are later delivered to the table, and takeaway coffee is strictly prohibited, which felt unnecessarily restrictive for a boutique property.

title: Moire Hoi An, Vignette Collection by IHG
text:
We stayed at Moire Hoi An for one night in a garden-view room, and it ended up being one of the best hotel experiences of our Vietnam trip.

From check-in, the staff made us feel very welcome. The welcome drink was delicious, and although the main lobby was under renovation, the hotel arranged a golf cart to take us to the check-in area, which made everything very smooth.

Our room was exceptionally clean, modern and beautifully designed. The fresh flowers on the table were such a nice touch and immediately made the room feel more special. The minibar was well stocked, the bathtub was large, and we also loved the hotel’s yellow colonial-style architecture.

What really made this stay memorable, though, was the staff. Harry was incredibly warm and helpful. He shared many recommendations about Hoi An, local food, Vietnamese coffee and Vietnamese culture, and talking with him added so much to our trip.

We also joined the hotel’s lantern boat activity in the evening. The bartender working on September 15 was wonderful. He made excellent cocktails, helped us take many beautiful photos, and spent time chatting with us during the boat ride. Since no other guests joined that evening, it almost felt like we had a private boat experience, and it became one of our favorite memories from Hoi An.

We also joined the complimentary Vietnamese coffee experience, which was both fun and interesting. It was a nice way to learn more about Vietnamese coffee culture and made the stay feel even more special. A big thank you as well to the staff member who led the activity on September 15 — we really enjoyed the experience and appreciated the warm and engaging introduction.

Breakfast by the river was also excellent. The view and atmosphere were beautiful, the food was delicious, and we especially enjoyed the freshly made salt coffee. The hotel also provides complimentary bicycles, and riding through the streets of Hoi An was a great experience.

The only downside was that construction noise outside our room was quite noticeable.

It would also be great if the hotel could offer more transportation options in the future, such as shuttle services to places like the coconut village or the beach.

Overall, the staff at Moire made our stay feel genuinely special. Their kindness, professionalism and willingness to share local culture made our Vietnam trip even better. We would absolutely stay here again.

text:
Summary – (5/5) Excellent 4-night stay at the Moire Hoi An, a hotel that feels intimate but manages to maintain the professional feel of a true 5* property.

Group – 1 Family, 4 Adults, 1 x 2 yr old & 1 x 10-month-old, divided into 1 pool villa and 1 premium room.

Pre Arrival – (5/5)
This was a last-minute booking while escaping from another hotel, we had requested early check-in as front desk got in touch via whatsapp before arrival.

Check In - (5/5)
Early check-in was granted on the Premium room with the Villa being ready shortly after, both rooms were available before standard 3pm time which was much appreciated with 2 small children.

Villa - (5/5)
Spotless, modern, well maintained and looked after. Very good use of space for storage to keep the living spaces uncluttered. All amenities feel as a 5* should. The private pool & garden create a very nice contrast to the hustle and bustle of Hoi An old town and a place to relax and watch the lantern boats go by at night.

Service – (5/5)
With 2 small children we did quite a lot of in room dining, everything was delivered and cleared very promptly. Front desk would answer whatsapp questions or help with external bookings very efficiently. Everyone was genuinely helpful and conducted their duties with care and professionalism.

Food – (4.5/5)
The Vietnamese food was very good on par if not better than most restaurants we tried in the old town. The French food from Julienne restaurant was unfortunately not as good, not bad, but it did not live up to the same sort of expectations as the rest of the services in the hotel did. I suspect this is lack of regular use and chef experience; most people don’t come to Hoi An to eat French food.

Further Notes
• The prices of food, services and amenities are very competitive, my family dinners at the Vietnamese restaurant were comparable in price to higher tier local restaurants in town. Extra services such as airport transfer were also decently priced.
• Hotel grounds are exceptionally maintained.
• Free of charge bicycles also with child seat are a very nice touch.

會安住宿選擇蠻多的，看了一輪決定住在外圍一點的地方，人車聲音的干擾會少很多，從飯店走到古城區大概15分鐘左右，沒下雨的話沿著河岸走過去或走馬路不算遠，不過9月開始是雨季，下雨就會有點不方便，因為沿途會有積水，人行道也不算完善，坑坑洞洞之外也會有汽機車占據。

入住有迎賓小點心，飯店2-7樓是住宿區，1樓是大廳泳池跟酒吧用餐區，地下室是健身房跟SPA區，這次選了河景房，有特別註明要高樓層，飯店也給了次頂樓，晚上看出去真的蠻漂亮的，河邊房舍燈光與月光映照在河岸上，偶爾有提燈小船經過，雖然時不時有喇叭聲，但隔音還算可以，晚上睡眠的時候不太會被干擾，衛浴是乾濕分離，浴缸蠻大的，越南飯店的通病好像都是水壓跟冷熱水不穩，發霉的部分也清楚可見，設備看起來跟拍起來有質感，不過用起來就像掏寶貨啷啷的。

一樓是早餐用餐區，第二天下樓的時候，可能還太早，越南人覺得不熱所以沒開冷氣，快八點吃到有點熱的時候才開，第三天下雨，天氣比較涼爽，所以也沒有開冷氣，用餐環境乾淨，選擇也算多，比後來去峴港住的號稱四星海景飯店好多了；這次選了飯店的SPA，一是不用舟車勞頓，二是可以先沖個澡再按摩比較舒服，價格算合理，雖然會問要重手普通還是柔軟，但整體感覺起來就是問而已，要柔軟感覺偏痛，太太要重手感覺偏軟，開始之前也有迎賓小點心，不過服務人員會站在前面，沒辦法有放鬆感，竹筒SPA就真的是拿加熱竹筒在身上滾，熱到刺，比較適合喜歡重手加皮厚一點的人。

這次住宿有含一次免費峴港機場接送到飯店，出機場就會看到接送人員拿著姓名紙板，如果透過飯店訂，接送到峴港的費用是30萬盾，看到之前評論說自己叫GRAB會比較便宜，而且飯店叫的車況也不太好，考量到雨季可能不好叫車，所以還是先透過飯店訂了車，當天接送的車是手排VIOS，確實車況偏舊，不過司機態度還OK。

以房價來說，會安應該還有更多更便宜的住宿，但六日一晚不到兩千的河景房，走路到古城區大約15分鐘，到會安秀大約10分鐘，距離算可以接受，只是如果有長輩或小孩的話，住在古城區還是會方便一些。
textTranslated:
There are many accommodation options in Hoi An. After looking around, I decided to stay a bit further out, where there would be much less noise from people and vehicles. It's about a 15-minute walk from the hotel to the Old Town. If it's not raining, it's not far to walk along the riverbank or the road. However, September is the rainy season, so it becomes a bit inconvenient when it rains, as there will be standing water along the way, and the sidewalks are not in good condition, full of potholes and often blocked by cars and motorcycles.

Welcome snacks were provided upon check-in. The hotel's floors 2-7 are the accommodation area, the first floor houses the lobby, swimming pool, bar, and dining area, and the basement contains a gym and spa. I chose a river-view room, specifically requesting a high floor, and the hotel provided a second-to-top floor. The view at night was truly beautiful; the lights of the riverside houses and the moonlight reflected on the riverbank, with occasional small boats carrying lanterns passing by. Although there were occasional horn sounds, the soundproofing was decent, and I wasn't disturbed much while sleeping at night. The bathroom had a separate shower and toilet, and the bathtub was quite large. A common problem with Vietnamese hotels seems to be unstable water pressure and hot/cold water; mold was also clearly visible. The equipment looked high-quality in photos, but in actual use, it felt like cheap, knock-off items.


The first floor is the breakfast dining area. When we went downstairs the next day, it was probably still too early; the Vietnamese didn't feel hot, so they didn't turn on the air conditioning. They only turned it on around 8 am when it got a little warm. On the third day, it rained, and the weather was cooler, so they didn't turn on the air conditioning either. The dining environment was clean, and the selection was quite good, much better than the supposedly four-star sea-view hotel we stayed at in Da Nang later. This time, we chose the hotel's spa. Firstly, we didn't have to travel long distances, and secondly, it was more comfortable to shower before the massage. The price was reasonable. Although they asked if we wanted a strong, regular, or gentle massage, it felt like they were just asking. The gentle massage felt a bit painful, while my wife's strong massage felt too soft. There were welcome snacks before the massage, but the staff stood in front of us, making it impossible to relax. The bamboo tube spa really involved rolling heated bamboo tubes over our bodies—it was so hot it hurt! It's more suitable for people who like a strong massage and have thicker skin.


This accommodation included one free airport transfer from Da Nang to the hotel. You'll see staff holding nameplates as you exit the airport. If you book through the hotel, the transfer to Da Nang costs 300,000 VND. Previous reviews mentioned that calling a Grab car is cheaper, and the hotel's rental cars weren't in great condition. Considering the rainy season and the potential difficulty in finding a ride, I booked through the hotel beforehand. The car used was a manual Vios, and it was indeed quite old, but the driver was okay.

In terms of price, there are probably more affordable accommodations in Hoi An, but a river-view room for less than 2,000 VND per night for six days is acceptable. It's about a 15-minute walk to the Old Town and about a 10-minute walk to the Hoi An Show. However, if you have elderly people or children, staying in the Old Town would be more convenient.
address: 128 Trần Quang Khải, Hội An Đông, Đà Nẵng 51000, Vietnam

text:
객실은 깨끗하고 뷰도 주변어느곳 보다 좋지만 복도는 온실화되어 매우 덥습니다 복도에 에어컨을 안키고 객실만 에어컨을 켜요 베란다에 저녁에 도마뱀이 올라올수 있고요 객실안으론 안들어와요 그리고 베트남 특유의 플라잉바퀴가 복도에 있는데 객실로 들어오긴 합니다만 객실 에어컨으로 온도가 낮아서 확률적으로 적습니다

조식은 종류와 규모로는 적은 편입니다만 맛으로는 평균이상은 나옵니다 쌀국수 날짜별로 소고기 닭고기등으로 바뀌구요 빵은 프랑스식 제빵으로 독일식 제빵과는 결이 다르지만 만족합니다 여기 닭고기볶음이 나온날 바게뜨 빵에 묻혀 먹으면 수준급 닭고기반미를 만들어 먹을수 있음

화장실 샤워기물을 깨끗하고요

밤12시부터 아침 10시까지 옆집에서 닭이 우는데 아침 10시쯤 되면 목이 쉰 소리가 날정도로 울다가 목이 쉬어서인가 그때쯤 멈춥니다

리모컨 배터리가 다운되서 먹통인데 여분에 배터리를 비치했으면 좋았을듯
textTranslated:
The rooms are clean and the view is better than anywhere else in the area, but the hallway is like a greenhouse and very hot. They don't turn on the air conditioning in the hallway, only in the rooms. Lizards might come up onto the balcony in the evening, but they don't enter the rooms. Also, there are flying cockroaches, typical of Vietnam, in the hallway; they do enter the rooms, but the probability is low because the room air conditioning keeps the temperature low.

The breakfast is on the smaller side in terms of variety and size, but the taste is above average. The pho changes daily with options like beef and chicken. The bread is French-style, which has a different texture than German bread, but I am satisfied. On days when stir-fried chicken is served, you can make a top-notch chicken banh mi by dipping a baguette in it.

The shower water in the bathroom is clean.

From midnight to 10 AM, a chicken from the next-door neighbor crows; by around 10 AM, it crows so loudly that its voice becomes hoarse, and then it stops, perhaps because its voice is hoarse.

The remote control stopped working because the battery died; it would have been nice if they had provided spare batteries.
address: 128 Trần Quang Khải, Hội An Đông, Đà Nẵng 51000, Vietnam

title: Cozy An Boutique Hotel Hoian
text:
Cozy An Boutique Hotel is a lovely, quaint property in a great location, about a 10 minute walk from Hoi An’s Old Town.

The location was perfect for us as it’s not too busy and we could stroll into the old town along the river or via the road. Near the hotel there are plenty of restaurants, spas, minimarts, coffee shops and a laundromat all within easy walking distance. There’s also a newly opened sports bar with the largest tv screen in Hoi An a few doors down serving AMAZING hot pies.

The hotel is beautifully decorated and has a good sized swimming pool, free bicycles and a buffet breakfast with a good variety of options. There is also a small gym, although we didn’t use it as there are only a few pieces of equipment. The rooms are a decent size, clean and have a nice view. As we’re travelling with kids, we opted for a family interconnecting room, which was well priced and adequate for what we needed.
address: 128 Trần Quang Khải, Hội An Đông, Đà Nẵng 51000, Vietnam

text:
7층 강변 뷰 객실로 예약해서 2박 했습니다.

다낭에서 무료 픽업 서비스도 이용할 수 있어서 택시비 약 1만 원도 아꼈습니다.

무엇보다 직원분들이 정말 친절했어요.
그중에서도 한국을 좋아하고 한국말도 조금 할 줄 아는 지주 직원분이 특히 친절하게 대해주셔서 감사했습니다.

옆에 있는 수영장도 관리가 잘 되어 있었고,
무료 자전거 대여도 있어서 아주 잘 이용했습니다.

오토바이를 탈 줄 아시는 분이라면 하루 150만 동 정도에 오토바이 대여도 추천드립니다.
주변을 돌아다니기 정말 편해요.

전체적으로 가격 대비 만족도가 높았고 직원분들도 너무 친절했습니다.

다음에 호이안에 다시 오게 된다면 무조건 다시 이용하고 싶은 숙소입니다.
textTranslated:
I booked a room with a river view on the 7th floor and stayed for two nights.

The price was about 150,000 won for two nights.

I was also able to use the free pickup service from Da Nang, so I saved about 10,000 won on taxi fare.

Above all, the staff were incredibly friendly.

I was especially grateful for the local staff member who liked Korea and could speak a little Korean and treated me with such kindness.

The breakfast was fresh and delicious, and since it was served from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM, I liked being able to enjoy a leisurely breakfast compared to other hotels.

The swimming pool next door was also well-maintained, and I made good use of the free bicycle rental service.

If you know how to ride a motorbike, I recommend renting one for about 1.5 million VND per day.

It is really convenient for getting around the area.

Overall, I was very satisfied with the value for money, and the staff were incredibly friendly.

If I come back to Hoi An, this is a place I definitely want to stay at again.

Your comments regarding the swimming pool have also been taken very seriously, as the safety and well-being of our guests are always our highest priority. Our pool has different depths ranging from 1.6 metres to 2.7 metres, with a lifeguard on duty daily from 6:00 to 21:00. We are pleased to know that you were safe following the incident. Nevertheless, we will reinforce our communication with the team to ensure that guests are clearly informed of the pool depths and lifeguard service hours, while maintaining close attention to pool safety at all times.

text:
Mình đã nghỉ 3 ngày tại phòng Dunan của KS Azerai Huế. Khu khách sạn này được xây dựng từ năm 1930 bởi người Pháp. Đến nay người ta vẫn giữ nguyên kiến trúc ban đầu, các vật dụng trong phòng được đặt riêng mô phỏng lại như những vật dùng trong khách sạn năm xưa. Tiếc là mình không chụp ảnh nền nhà - nếu bạn là người yêu thích lịch sử thì nó giống ban đầu lắm.
Một vài điểm khác với các khách sạn 5 sao phong cách hiện đại là nhân viên sẽ dọn phòng 2 lần, trên quầy bar trong phòng luôn có các loại hạt (khi mình ở có sen điều lạc , cũng ngon ), hoa quả tươi và bánh ngọt thay đổi mỗi ngày.
Nhân viên rất nhiệt tình và breakfast rất tươi ngon
textTranslated:
I stayed for 3 days in the Dunan room at the Azerai Hotel in Hue. This hotel was built in 1930 by the French. To this day, the original architecture is still preserved, and the room furnishings are custom-made to resemble those used in the hotel back then. It's a shame I didn't take pictures of the floor – if you're a history buff, it looks very much like the original.

A few differences from modern 5-star hotels are that the staff cleans the room twice, the bar always has nuts (we had cashews and peanuts, which were delicious), fresh fruit, and pastries that change daily.

The staff were very enthusiastic, and the breakfast was very fresh and delicious.

Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang

I would love to visit again when I travel to Vietnam!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Ein wunderschönes, kreatives und unglaublich beruhigendes Erlebnis – pure Magie in Hội An! 🏮🎨✨❤️

Wer in Hội An etwas ganz Besonderes erleben möchte, sollte unbedingt einmal eine traditionelle vietnamesische Laterne selbst bemalen!

Für uns war dieser Workshop eine wunderschöne Erfahrung und eine herrliche Abwechslung zum Trubel des Reisens.

Es ist unglaublich, wie entspannend und beruhigend es sein kann, eine Laterne mit den eigenen Händen zu gestalten!

Man sitzt gemütlich da, konzentriert sich auf die Farben, die Muster und die kleinen Details und vergisst dabei vollkommen die Zeit. Fast schon wie eine kleine Meditation!

Besonders schön finde ich, dass man seiner Kreativität freien Lauf lassen kann. Jede Laterne wird zu einem ganz persönlichen kleinen Kunstwerk, das es so kein zweites Mal gibt.

Die vielen wunderschönen Farben, die liebevolle Handarbeit und die besondere Atmosphäre machen dieses Erlebnis wirklich einzigartig.

Es hat etwas unglaublich Friedliches, eine traditionelle Laterne zu bemalen und dabei einfach den Moment zu geniessen. ❤️

Gerade in einer so märchenhaften Stadt wie Hội An, die für ihre unzähligen leuchtenden Laternen bekannt ist, passt dieser Workshop einfach perfekt.

Statt nur durch die Strassen zu schlendern und die wunderschönen Laternen zu bewundern, darf man selbst kreativ werden und ein Stück dieser besonderen Tradition erleben.

Und das Allerschönste: Am Ende nimmt man nicht einfach irgendein Souvenir mit nach Hause, sondern eine selbst gestaltete Erinnerung an Vietnam!

Eine Laterne, in der Zeit, Kreativität und ganz viele schöne Feriengefühle stecken. 🏮

Für mich sind es genau solche Erlebnisse, die eine Reise besonders machen. Nicht immer müssen es grosse Sehenswürdigkeiten oder spektakuläre Ausflüge sein. Manchmal sind es gerade die ruhigen, kreativen Momente, die einem besonders lange in Erinnerung bleiben.

Ich kann diesen Workshop allen empfehlen, die gerne kreativ sind, etwas Entspannendes unternehmen möchten oder einfach eine wunderschöne Erinnerung an Hội An mit nach Hause nehmen wollen.

Ein kleines Stück Magie, ganz viel Ruhe und ein wunderbares Erlebnis für die Seele!

Vielen herzlichen Dank für diese schöne Erfahrung!

title: Le Family Riders
text:
¡Una de las mejores experiencias de nuestro viaje por Vietnam! 🇻🇳❤️

Tuvimos la suerte de encontrarnos con Lui por casualidad a las afueras de la Ciudad Imperial de Hué. Nos pusimos a charlar con él, nos contó en qué consistían sus excursiones y, aunque no entraba en nuestros planes, nos pareció un planazo y acabó convenciéndonos. ¡Y menos mal que lo hicimos, porque fue todo un acierto!

Pasamos un día increíble recorriendo en moto los alrededores de Hoi An y Da Nang junto a Lo y Luong. Además de ser unos conductores estupendos, son dos personas encantadoras, divertidas y ¡unos fotógrafos maravillosos! 📸 Se preocuparon en todo momento de que estuviéramos cómodas y disfrutáramos de cada parada.

Lo que más nos gustó fue la combinación de lugares turísticos con rincones mucho menos conocidos, de esos que probablemente nunca habríamos descubierto por nuestra cuenta. Uno de los momentos más especiales fue parar en una cascada preciosa donde pudimos darnos un baño y refrescarnos en plena naturaleza. ¡Una auténtica maravilla!

Para terminar el día, comimos en un chiringuito estupendo junto a la playa. ¡No se nos ocurre un final mejor!

Más allá de los lugares que visitamos, lo que hizo realmente especial esta experiencia fue compartir el día con ellos. Se nota que disfrutan de lo que hacen y consiguen que te sientas como si estuvieras descubriendo Vietnam con dos amigos.

Si estáis por Hoi An o Da Nang, no lo dudéis. Es una forma diferente, auténtica y divertidísima de conocer la zona. ¡Repetiríamos sin pensarlo!

¡Muchísimas gracias, Lui , Lo y Luong, por un día inolvidable! ❤️
textTranslated:
One of the best experiences of our trip to Vietnam! 🇻🇳❤️

We were lucky enough to bump into Lui by chance on the outskirts of the Imperial City of Hue. We started chatting with him, he told us about his excursions, and although it wasn't in our plans, it sounded like a fantastic idea and he ended up convincing us. And we're so glad we did, because it was a great decision!

We spent an incredible day exploring the areas around Hoi An and Da Nang by motorbike with Lo and Luong. Besides being excellent drivers, they are two lovely, fun people and amazing photographers! 📸 They made sure we were comfortable and enjoyed every stop.

What we loved most was the combination of tourist spots with much lesser-known corners, places we probably would never have discovered on our own. One of the most special moments was stopping at a beautiful waterfall where we could take a dip and cool off surrounded by nature. Absolutely wonderful!

To end the day, we had lunch at a fantastic beach bar. We couldn't have asked for a better ending!

Beyond the places we visited, what made this experience truly special was sharing the day with them. You can tell they enjoy what they do, and they make you feel like you're discovering Vietnam with two friends.

If you're in Hoi An or Da Nang, don't hesitate. It's a different, authentic, and incredibly fun way to explore the area. We would do it again in a heartbeat!

Thank you so much, Lui, Lo, and Luong, for an unforgettable day! ❤️

title: Imperial Craft Bia Brewpub
text:
Hôm qua, tôi lại ghé cửa hàng của anh Shaun, lần này cùng với những người bạn của tôi là Pieter và Philip.
Đây là lần thứ hai tôi đến đây, và lần này tôi quyết định thử một loại beer khác với lần trước. Tôi không nhớ tên chính xác, nhưng beer có hương dứa rất đặc trưng và tôi khá thích nó. 🍺🍍
Sau lần đầu tiên chỉ thưởng thức beer và burger, lần này chúng tôi quyết định thử thêm pizza. Và thật sự, pizza ở đây rất đáng để thử. Đế bánh, phần topping và hương vị đều rất ổn. Đặc biệt, chúng tôi còn được thưởng thức thêm xúc xích của “Pieter mập” — một món ăn kèm rất thú vị trong buổi tối hôm đó. 😄
Một điều tôi rất thích ở đây là không gian.
Bạn bè tôi khá thích hút thuốc nên chúng tôi có thể ngồi ở khu vực bên ngoài, vừa uống beer vừa trò chuyện thoải mái. Nhưng nếu đi cùng gia đình thì bên trong vẫn có không gian máy lạnh và đặc biệt còn có bàn bi lắc bóng đá cho con gái tôi.
Thế là người lớn có thể thoải mái ngồi nói chuyện với nhau, còn con gái tôi vẫn có không gian để vui chơi. Một buổi tối mà ai cũng có thể tận hưởng theo cách của mình. ❤️
Nếu bạn đang tìm một nơi để uống một ly beer ngon, ăn những món chất lượng và có không gian phù hợp cả cho bạn bè lẫn gia đình, thì tôi nghĩ Iperial là một địa điểm đáng để ghé thử.
Hẹn gặp lại Shaun và mọi người trong lần tới! 🍺🍕
textTranslated:
Yesterday, I visited Shaun's shop again, this time with my friends Pieter and Philip.

This was my second time here, and this time I decided to try a different beer than last time. I don't remember the exact name, but the beer had a very distinctive pineapple flavor and I quite liked it. 🍺🍍
After the first time just enjoying beer and burgers, this time we decided to try the pizza as well. And honestly, the pizza here is worth trying. The crust, toppings, and flavor were all great. Especially, we got to enjoy "Fat Pieter's" sausages—a very interesting side dish that evening. 😄
One thing I really liked here was the atmosphere.

My friends are quite fond of smoking, so we could sit outside, enjoying beer and chatting comfortably. But if you're with family, there's still an air-conditioned indoor area, and especially, there's a foosball table for my daughter.

So the adults could comfortably sit and chat with each other, while my daughter still had space to play. An evening where everyone could enjoy themselves in their own way. ❤️
If you're looking for a place to enjoy a good beer, eat quality food, and have a space suitable for both friends and family, then I think Iperial is a place worth trying.
See you next time, Shaun and everyone! 🍺🍕

text:
비가 와서 다수의 매장이 문을 닫아 아기자기한 마을의 전경을 못봐 아쉬웠지만 고지대에 이렇게 멋진 건축물들이 있다는게 경이로웠습니다. 케이블카를 타고 제일 먼저 도착하는 고지대쪽 말고는 식사할 수 있는 곳이 적어 아쉬웠습니다.
바나힐 스탭들은 친절했으나 상점가 직원들은 불친절해서 별로 구매욕구는 일어나지 않았습니다.
골든브릿지 상점가에서 앞쪽 쇼케이스를 보고 젤라또를 주문했는데 실제로 퍼준 뒷쪽 쇼케이스의 아이스크림은 젤라또라고 하기엔 부족한 맛이였습니다.
비가 와도 경관이 멋져 쥬라기공원속에 들어와있는 기분이였습니다.
생각보다 많이 높아 고소공포증이 있는 분들은 힘들겠습니다.
textTranslated:
It was a shame that many shops were closed due to the rain, so I couldn't see the scenery of the charming village, but it was awe-inspiring to see such magnificent architecture located at such a high altitude. It was disappointing that there were few places to eat other than the high-altitude area, which is the first stop after taking the cable car.

The Bana Hills staff were friendly, but the shopkeepers were unfriendly, so I didn't feel much desire to make a purchase.

At the Golden Bridge shopping area, I ordered gelato after looking at the display case at the front, but the ice cream actually scooped from the back display case was lacking in flavor to be called gelato.

Even with the rain, the scenery was magnificent, making me feel like I was inside Jurassic Park.

It is much higher than I expected, so it would be difficult for those with a fear of heights.

title: Ba Na Hills SunWorld
text:
Quá nhiều hoạt động để trải nghiệm tại nơi đây, đợt nhà mình đi vào tháng 8 còn có cả Lễ hội bia Sun Fest uống SunKraft Beer xả láng. Mỗi khách còn được phát 1 voucher lúc mới vào cổng để đổi 2 bia hoặc 1 món nhắm nhẹ.

Tất nhiên không thể không kể đến đoạn cáp treo “lướt” quá khu rừng nguyên sơ kỳ vĩ của Bà Nà, quá mãn nhãn.

Nên đi sớm và có mặt ở đây từ 8h sẽ tránh được khách đoàn và đỡ đông. Cáp treo hoạt động từ 8h đến 17h. Từ ngoài cổng đến vào khu cáp cũng kéo khá nhiều, có thể mua vé wow pass 300k/ khách để rút ngắn quãng đường đi bộ.

Giá cả các nhà hàng cũng khá mềm so với địa thế “độc quyền” ở đây.

Bãi đỗ xe gia đình 4-7 chỗ sẽ ở ngoài, sau đó đi shuttle bus lên. Mùa hè dẫn cả gia đình đi chơi là hợp lý nhất. Trong khi người lớn có thể khám phá hầm rượu, làm ly vang ngắm nhìn toàn cảnh Bà Nà thì “người trẻ” có thể chơi các trò chơi mạo hiểm khá kỳ thú.

Thời tiết se se, có nắng nhẹ, ngồi uống ly bia hoặc tách cà phê trên này thì không còn gì bằng.
textTranslated:
There are so many things to experience here. When we went in August, there was even the Sun Fest beer festival where you could drink all the SunKraft Beer you wanted. Each guest also received a voucher upon entry to redeem for two beers or a light snack.

Of course, we can't forget the cable car ride gliding over the magnificent pristine forest of Ba Na Hills – it was breathtaking.

It's best to arrive early, around 8 am, to avoid large groups and crowds. The cable car operates from 8 am to 5 pm. There are quite a few people walking from the entrance to the cable car area; you can buy a Wow Pass for 300k VND per person to shorten the walk.

The prices at the restaurants are also quite reasonable considering the "exclusive" location.

Family parking for 4-7 seater cars is outside, then you take a shuttle bus up. Summer is the best time to visit with the whole family. While adults can explore the wine cellar, enjoy a glass of wine while admiring the panoramic view of Ba Na Hills, younger people can enjoy exciting adventure games.

The weather is cool and sunny; sitting here with a beer or a cup of coffee is simply wonderful.

Để hết được các trò chơi nên đi cả ngày nhé
textTranslated: Ba Na Hills is a nature reserve and resort complex located in Hoa Ninh commune, Hoa Vang district. It's approximately 25 km southwest of Da Nang city center. The entire complex sits atop Mount Chua, part of the Truong Son mountain range, at an altitude of 1,487 meters above sea level. The cable car operates from 8 AM to 10 PM. After reaching the summit, it's recommended to visit the information desk to receive a map of Ba Na Hills and directions from various stations such as Hoi An station, Suoi Mo station, Ba Na station, or Morin station. To fully enjoy all the activities, a full day is recommended.

title: Linh Ung Pagoda
text:
Chùa Linh Ứng – Vẻ đẹp Phật giáo giữa thiên nhiên Sơn Trà

Chùa Linh Ứng là một trong những địa điểm tâm linh đẹp và đáng ghé thăm nhất tại Đà Nẵng.

Ngôi chùa mang đậm nét kiến trúc Phật giáo Việt Nam với mái ngói cong, những họa tiết tinh xảo, hệ thống tượng Phật trang nghiêm và đặc biệt là tượng Quan Thế Âm Bồ Tát uy nghi hướng ra biển Đông.

Điều ấn tượng nhất là sự kết hợp hài hòa giữa kiến trúc Phật giáo truyền thống, không gian thanh tịnh và cảnh sắc thiên nhiên hùng vĩ của bán đảo Sơn Trà. Nơi đây thể hiện những giá trị tốt đẹp của đạo Phật như lòng từ bi, trí tuệ và sự bình an trong tâm hồn.

Một điểm thú vị khác là những đàn khỉ sinh sống tự nhiên quanh khu vực chùa. Du khách có thể bắt gặp những chú khỉ leo trèo trên cây, vui đùa cùng nhau hoặc thong thả di chuyển trong khuôn viên. Sự xuất hiện của chúng khiến không gian nơi đây thêm sinh động và gần gũi với thiên nhiên. Tuy nhiên, du khách nên giữ khoảng cách và không cho khỉ ăn để bảo vệ động vật hoang dã.

Đây không chỉ là nơi chiêm bái, cầu bình an mà còn là địa điểm tuyệt vời để tìm hiểu văn hóa Phật giáo Việt Nam, tận hưởng thiên nhiên và tìm lại sự tĩnh tại trong tâm hồn.

Một trải nghiệm rất đáng nhớ khi đến Đà Nẵng. Rất đáng ghé thăm!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Linh Ung Pagoda – A Beautiful Buddhist Temple in Nature

Linh Ung Pagoda is one of the most beautiful and peaceful places to visit in Da Nang.

The pagoda has traditional Vietnamese Buddhist architecture, with curved roofs, beautiful decorations, and many Buddha statues. The most impressive part is the large Lady Buddha statue facing the sea.

I really enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere and the amazing views of Son Tra Peninsula. The temple shows important Buddhist values such as kindness, compassion, wisdom, and inner peace.

Another interesting thing is the wild monkeys living around the pagoda. Visitors may see monkeys climbing trees, playing together, or walking around the temple grounds. They make this place feel more natural and lively. However, visitors should keep a safe distance and avoid feeding them.

This is not only a place to pray for peace and good health, but also a wonderful place to learn about Vietnamese Buddhist culture, enjoy nature, and relax your mind.

A beautiful and unforgettable experience in Da Nang. Highly recommended!

text:
Chùa Linh Ứng là một trong những địa điểm du lịch nổi tiếng và có ý nghĩa tâm linh của thành phố Đà Nẵng. Chùa nằm trên bán đảo Sơn Trà, giữa khung cảnh thiên nhiên xanh mát, hướng ra biển Đông. Đây là nơi thu hút đông đảo người dân và du khách đến tham quan, chiêm bái mỗi năm.

Điểm nổi bật nhất của chùa là tượng Phật Quan Thế Âm cao khoảng 67 mét, đứng uy nghi trên núi và hướng về phía biển. Tượng Phật không chỉ tạo nên vẻ đẹp đặc biệt cho ngôi chùa mà còn mang ý nghĩa cầu mong bình an, may mắn cho người dân và những người đi biển. Ngoài ra, chùa còn có chính điện, các tượng La Hán và khuôn viên rộng rãi, sạch đẹp.

Đến với Chùa Linh Ứng, du khách có thể vừa tìm hiểu về văn hóa Phật giáo, vừa ngắm nhìn cảnh biển và thành phố Đà Nẵng từ trên cao. Với vẻ đẹp hài hòa giữa thiên nhiên và kiến trúc, Chùa Linh Ứng đã trở thành một biểu tượng du lịch của Đà Nẵng và là điểm đến đáng nhớ đối với mỗi du khách.
textTranslated:
Linh Ung Pagoda is one of the most famous and spiritually significant tourist destinations in Da Nang city. Located on the Son Tra Peninsula, amidst lush greenery and overlooking the East Sea, it attracts a large number of locals and tourists every year.

The most striking feature of the pagoda is the approximately 67-meter-tall statue of the Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, standing majestically on the mountain and facing the sea. The statue not only adds a unique beauty to the pagoda but also symbolizes a wish for peace and good fortune for the people and those who go to sea. In addition, the pagoda has a main hall, Arhat statues, and a spacious, clean, and beautiful grounds.

Visiting Linh Ung Pagoda, tourists can learn about Buddhist culture while enjoying panoramic views of the sea and Da Nang city from above. With its harmonious blend of nature and architecture, Linh Ung Pagoda has become a tourism icon of Da Nang and a memorable destination for every visitor.

title: Linh Ung Temple
text:
傳說在阮朝明命帝時期的某天清晨,此地的漁民偶然 發現了一尊從沙灘中升起的佛像,村民們欣喜若狂, 修建了寵供奉佛像,並將此地命名為「佛灘(Bái But)」。此後,海浪變得平靜,漁民們也變得富裕。
2004年,釋善願上座(Thuong toa Thich Thièn Nguyèn,俗名胡新)動員遠近佛子捐款修建靈應佛 灘寺。該寺於2004年7月4日(農曆猴年六月十 九日)動工,經過6年建設,於2010年7月30日 (農曆虎年六月十九日)竣工[2]。之後,釋善願上座 持續擔任靈應寺的住持,直到上座於2016年圓寂。

靈應佛灘寺的大雄寶殿主祀釋迦牟尼佛,左、右偏殿 則分別供奉觀世音菩薩和地藏王菩薩。正對面是「羅 漢園」,園內有用白色石頭雕刻而成的十八羅漢雕 像。寺廟旁的巨大觀世音菩薩像是靈應佛灘寺最著名 的地標。靈應佛灘寺佔地20公頃,是三座靈應 寺中佔地面積最大的。
2017年,峴港市人民委員會將靈應佛灘寺設為岷港 市地方旅遊景點。
textTranslated:
Legend has it that one morning during the reign of Emperor Minh Mang of the Nguyen Dynasty, fishermen in this area accidentally discovered a Buddha statue rising from the beach. The villagers were overjoyed and built a temple to enshrine the Buddha statue, naming the place "Buddha Beach (Bái But)". After that, the sea became calm, and the fishermen became wealthy. In 2004, Abbot Thuong Toa Thich Thièn Nguyèn (whose secular name was Hu Xin) mobilized Buddhists from near and far to donate funds to build the Linh Ung Buddha Beach Pagoda. Construction of the pagoda began on July 4, 2004 (the 19th day of the sixth month of the Year of the Monkey in the lunar calendar) and was completed on July 30, 2010 (the 19th day of the sixth month of the Year of the Tiger in the lunar calendar) after six years of construction.[2] Abbot Thuong Toa Thich Thièn Nguyèn continued to serve as the abbot of Linh Ung Pagoda until his death in 2016. The main hall of Linh Ung Phu Tan Pagoda enshrines Shakyamuni Buddha, while the left and right side halls enshrine Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva respectively. Directly opposite is the "Arhat Garden," containing eighteen Arhat statues carved from white stone. The enormous Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva statue next to the temple is the most famous landmark of Linh Ung Phu Tan Pagoda. Covering 20 hectares, Linh Ung Phu Tan Pagoda is the largest of the three Linh Ung Pagodas.

In 2017, the Da Nang City People's Committee designated Linh Ung Phu Tan Pagoda as a local tourist attraction in Da Nang City.

Vietnam's tallest white jade Guanyin statue is approximately 67-70 meters high (about 30 stories tall). The square in front of the temple offers panoramic views of the beautiful coastline of My Khe Beach and the Da Nang skyline. Weather was ideal for a September afternoon visit. I happened to encounter many tourists here; the view of My Khe Beach coastline is beautiful and highly recommended!

**Da Nang has three Linh Ung Pagodas, one of which is on Son Tra Peninsula. The other two are scattered around the Marble Mountains and Ba Na Hills.**

**When visiting temples, it's best to wear sleeved tops, long trousers, and shoes that cover your feet.** In Da Nang, temples will allow visitors wearing shorts to worship without being stopped. However, at entrances to temples like Tran Quoc Pagoda in Hanoi, locals may try to stop visitors and sell long trousers and scarves.

**Da Nang attractions include:** My Khe Beach, My Son Sanctuary, Linh Ung Pagoda on the Marble Mountains, Ba Na Hills, Pink Cathedral, Han Market, Hoi An, and Hue.

title: My Son Sanctuary
text:
My Son Sanctuary, Vietnam 🇻🇳✨

Stepping back in time at My Son Sanctuary, one of Vietnam’s most remarkable historical treasures.

Built by the ancient Champa Kingdom between the 4th and 13th centuries, this impressive complex of red-brick Hindu temples was once an important religious and spiritual center. Dedicated mainly to the Hindu god Shiva, the sanctuary reflects the rich culture, beliefs, and architectural skills of the ancient Cham civilization.

Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1999, My Son is a fascinating place where history, culture, and nature come together. Despite centuries of history and damage caused by war, these ancient ruins still stand as a powerful reminder of a glorious civilization.

Walking among these mysterious brick towers, surrounded by green mountains and blue skies, felt like traveling back hundreds of years. A beautiful and unforgettable experience! ❤️

VND 500,000 (It's recommended to arrange a return trip with the driver from Da Nang city to My Son Sanctuary)

✖️Entirely outdoor attraction, not recommended to visit on rainy days

It's recommended to arrive around 9:00 AM in the hot month of September, when there are fewer tourists and the sun is shining brightly. Enjoy strolling through the ruins with a parasol. This place is also known as the Vietnamese version of Angkor Wat. Since it's entirely outdoors with limited shade, you'll need to stay hydrated frequently. Ice water is available for purchase within the park. VND 15,000/bottle, popsicles, cold drinks, etc. Half-day tour groups begin arriving after 10:00 AM, and the crowds increase as the weather gets hotter. The park isn't large, but the ruins are scattered throughout, requiring a lot of walking. Some areas are under restoration/maintenance... If you're not particularly interested in the ruins, you might think it's just a photo opportunity, but it's quite a drive from Da Nang, so you should assess whether your overall travel plans are suitable.

Da Nang attractions include: My Khe Beach, Linh Ung Pagoda at Marble Mountains, Linh Ung Pagoda at Son Tra Peninsula, Ba Na Hills, Pink Cathedral, Han Market, Hoi An, and Hue.

title: Hue Imperial City
text:
Hoàng Thành Huế (Đại Nội) là "trái tim" của quần thể di tích Cố đô Huế – Di sản Văn hóa Thế giới được UNESCO công nhận từ năm 1993. Toàn cảnh Đại Nội Huế còn lưu giữ nhiều dấu ấn đặc sắc của triều đình nhà Nguyễn – triều đại phong kiến cuối cùng trong lịch sử Việt Nam.
Hoàng thành Huế là vòng thành thứ hai bên trong Kinh thành Huế, có chức năng bảo vệ các cung điện quan trọng nhất của triều đình, các miếu thờ tổ tiên nhà Nguyễn và bảo vệ Tử Cấm thành - nơi dành riêng cho vua và hoàng gia.
Hoàng thành được xây dựng năm 1804. Hoàng thành có mặt bằng gần vuông, xây bằng gạch, xung quanh có hào bảo vệ, có 4 cửa để ra vào. Các cầu và hồ được đào chung quanh phía ngoài thành đều có tên Kim Thủy.
Hoàng thành và toàn bộ hệ thống cung điện bên trong được bố trí trên một trục đối xứng, trong đó trục chính giữa được bố trí các công trình chỉ dành cho vua. Các công trình ở hai bên được phân bố chặt chẽ theo từng khu vực, tuân thủ nguyên tắc "tả nam hữu nữ", "tả văn hữu võ". Ngay cả trong các miếu thờ cũng có sự sắp xếp theo thứ tự "tả chiêu hữu mục" (bên trái trước, bên phải sau, lần lượt theo thời gian).
Hoàng thành gồm các khu vực:
1. Khu vực phòng vệ: gồm vòng thành bao quanh bên ngoài, cổng thành, các hồ (hào), cầu và đài quan sát.
2. Khu vực cử hành đại lễ, gồm các công trình:
- Ngọ Môn, cửa chính của Hoàng thành - nơi tổ chức lễ Duyệt Binh, lễ Truyền Lô (đọc tên các Tiến sĩ tân khoa), lễ Ban Sóc (ban lịch năm mới).
- Thái Hòa điện - nơi cử hành các cuộc lễ Đại Triều một tháng 2 lần (vào ngày 1 và 15 Âm lịch), lễ Đăng Quang, lễ Vạn Thọ, lễ Quốc Khánh...
3. Khu vực các miếu thờ: được bố trí ở phía trước, hai bên trục dọc của Hoàng thành theo thứ tự từ trong ra gồm:
- Triệu Tổ Miếu ở bên trái thờ Nguyễn Kim.
- Thái Tổ Miếu thờ các vị chúa Nguyễn.
- Hưng Tổ Miếu ở bên phải Nguyễn Phúc Luân.
- Thế Tổ Miếu thờ các vị vua nhà Nguyễn.
4. Khu vực dành cho bà nội và mẹ vua (phía sau, bên phải), gồm hệ thống Trường Sanh cung (dành cho các Thái hoàng thái hậu) và Diên Thọ cung (dành cho các Hoàng thái hậu).
5. Khu vực dành cho các hoàng tử học tập, giải trí như vườn Cơ Hạ, điện Khâm văn... (phía sau, bên trái).
6. Ngoài ra còn có kho tàng (Phủ Nội vụ) và các xưởng chế tạo đồ dùng cho hoàng gia (phía trước vườn Cơ Hạ)
7. Khu vực Tử Cấm thành nằm trên cùng một trục Bắc-Nam với Hoàng thành và Kinh thành, gồm một vòng tường thành bao quanh khu vực các cung điện như:
- Cần Chánh điện (nơi vua tổ chức lễ Thường triều).
- Càn Thành điện (chỗ ở của vua).
- Khôn Thái điện (chỗ ở của Hoàng Quý phi).
- Kiến Trung điện (từng là nơi ở của vua Bảo Đại và Hoàng hậu Nam Phương), trước đây là Minh Viễn lâu.
- Nhà đọc sách và các công trình khác phục vụ cho nhu cầu sinh hoạt của nhà vua và gia đình như Thượng Thiện đường (nơi phục vụ ăn uống), Duyệt Thị đường (nhà hát hoàng cung)...
textTranslated:
The Imperial Citadel of Hue (Dai Noi) is the "heart" of the Hue Imperial City complex – a UNESCO World Heritage site since 1993. The entire Imperial Citadel of Hue still preserves many distinctive features of the Nguyen Dynasty – the last feudal dynasty in Vietnamese history.

The Imperial Citadel of Hue is the second inner wall of the Hue Citadel, serving to protect the most important palaces of the court, the ancestral temples of the Nguyen Dynasty, and the Forbidden City – the area reserved exclusively for the king and royal family.

The Imperial Citadel was built in 1804. It has a nearly square layout, is built of brick, surrounded by a moat, and has four gates. The bridges and lakes dug around the outside of the citadel are all named Kim Thuy (Gold and Water).

The Imperial Citadel and the entire system of palaces inside are arranged on a symmetrical axis, with the central axis containing structures reserved exclusively for the king. The structures on both sides are meticulously arranged according to area, adhering to the principle of "left for men, right for women," and "left for literature, right for martial arts." Even within the temples, there is an arrangement in the order of "left first, right second" (left first, right second, in chronological order).

The Imperial Citadel comprises the following areas:
1. Defense area: including the outer city wall, city gates, moats, bridges, and observation towers.

2. Area for grand ceremonies, including the following structures:
- Ngo Mon Gate, the main gate of the Imperial Citadel - where the Military Review, the Ceremony of Announcing the Names of the New Doctors of Literature, and the Ceremony of Granting the New Year's Calendar were held.

- Thai Hoa Palace - where the Grand Court ceremonies were held twice a month (on the 1st and 15th of the lunar calendar), the Coronation Ceremony, the Longevity Ceremony, the National Day Ceremony, etc.
3. The area of ​​the temples: arranged in front, on both sides of the vertical axis of the Imperial Citadel in order from inside out, including:
- Trieu To Temple on the left, dedicated to Nguyen Kim.

- Thai To Temple, dedicated to the Nguyen lords.

- Hung To Temple on the right, dedicated to Nguyen Phuc Luan.

- The To Temple, dedicated to the Nguyen kings.

4. The area for the king's grandmother and mother (behind, on the right), including the Truong Sanh Palace (for the Grand Empress Dowagers) and Dien Tho Palace (for the Empress Dowagers).

5. The area for the princes' studies and recreation, such as Co Ha Garden, Kham Van Palace, etc. (behind, on the left).

6. In addition, there are the treasury (Ministry of the Interior) and workshops for manufacturing royal goods (in front of the Co Ha garden).
7. The Forbidden City area is located on the same North-South axis as the Imperial Citadel and the Royal City, consisting of a wall surrounding the palace area such as:
- Can Chanh Palace (where the king held the regular court ceremony).

- Can Thanh Palace (the king's residence).

- Khon Thai Palace (the residence of the Imperial Consort).

title: Hue Imperial City
text:
One of the absolute highlights of my visit to Vietnam. The Imperial City is a magnificent historical complex, with an extraordinary combination of grand architecture, beautifully decorated buildings, impressive gateways and peaceful gardens.

The sheer scale of the site is remarkable, but it is the smaller architectural details that make it particularly special. Intricate carvings, colourful ceramic decorations, elaborate rooflines and wonderful dragon sculptures are everywhere. The ornamental ponds, filled with lotus plants and colourful koi carp, provide a lovely contrast to the imposing buildings and fortifications.

It is also a fascinating place to appreciate Vietnam’s imperial history, particularly the legacy of the Nguyễn dynasty. There is so much to explore, and the combination of restored buildings and historic structures makes for a memorable visit.

Allow several hours to explore properly, take your time and look beyond the main buildings. An absolutely unmissable attraction when visiting Huế.

title: Monkey World
text:
At first, I thought the ticket price was a little expensive, but after visiting Monkey World, I felt it was absolutely worth it.

As you walk around, you can read each animal’s story and learn about Monkey World’s history, including how the rescued monkeys and apes came to be there. Many have suffered abuse, neglect or poor treatment, and some live with lasting injuries or disabilities. Seeing them now—lively, cared for and able to enjoy a better life—was really moving.

The visit made me reflect on how cruel people can be, but also reminded me that there are people who dedicate themselves to protecting and caring for these animals. It was a surreal and emotional experience, and I came away feeling even more empathy for them.

My partner loves animals and enjoys visiting zoos and animal parks, so it was a special experience for him too. I’d happily bring friends and family to Monkey World if they visit from overseas. It’s a place I’d gladly visit again.

title: Mausoleum of Emperor Khai Dinh
text:
If you only have time to visit one emperor’s tomb in Huế, I would strongly recommend this one. It was one of the absolute highlights of our trip to Vietnam and well worth the taxi ride out of the city.

The architecture is extraordinary. The exterior has an almost Gothic appearance, with dark, weathered stone, imposing stairways, elaborate carvings and dramatic statues. It is impressive enough in its own right, but nothing quite prepares you for the interior.

Inside, the contrast is breathtaking. The walls and columns are covered in incredibly intricate, colourful ceramic and glass mosaics, with magnificent dragons, elaborate decorative ceilings and a richly ornamented imperial shrine. The sheer level of craftsmanship and attention to detail is astonishing. Everywhere you look, there is something new to admire.

The setting, surrounded by wooded hills, adds to the atmosphere, and the combination of imposing exterior architecture and dazzling interior decoration makes this a truly memorable place.

An exceptional historical monument and an absolute must-see when visiting Huế. Five stars without hesitation.

textTranslated: What has been preserved and maintained in the site is quite good. However, the small parts of some towers restored by the craftsmen seem a bit forced... Information is not publicly available, and visitors have to pay extra to hire a guide at the site or scan a QR code; the reliefs inscribed with ancient Sanskrit script have not been fully translated, and the translated parts are not widely disseminated, leaving visitors without enough information to fully understand and pay deeper attention. If visitors could gain a deeper understanding of the site, they could share their experiences with their friends and family, and perhaps more tourists would visit the site...

title: Han River Bridge Viewpoint
text:
Cầu Sông Hàn, biểu tượng kiến trúc độc đáo của Đà Nẵng, không chỉ là một công trình giao thông mà còn là niềm tự hào của người dân địa phương và điểm đến hấp dẫn du khách. Khánh thành vào năm 2000, đây là cây cầu xoay đầu tiên và duy nhất tại Việt Nam do chính kỹ sư, công nhân Việt Nam thiết kế và thi công, thể hiện sự vươn lên mạnh mẽ của thành phố.
Với chiều dài 487,7m, rộng 12,9m, cầu Sông Hàn nối liền hai trục đường chính là Lê Duẩn (bờ Tây) và Phạm Văn Đồng (bờ Đông), đóng vai trò huyết mạch trong việc kết nối giao thông, thúc đẩy kinh tế và du lịch. Điểm đặc biệt nhất của cầu chính là khả năng xoay 90 độ quanh trục vào ban đêm, tạo lối đi cho các tàu thuyền lớn qua lại. Khoảnh khắc cầu xoay, đặc biệt là vào các đêm cuối tuần (thường vào khoảng 23h), là một trải nghiệm độc đáo, thu hút đông đảo du khách và người dân đến chiêm ngưỡng.
Về đêm, cầu Sông Hàn khoác lên mình "chiếc áo" lung linh với hệ thống đèn chiếu sáng rực rỡ, tạo nên một khung cảnh huyền ảo, thơ mộng trên dòng sông. Du khách có thể lựa chọn đi dạo trên cầu, ngắm nhìn thành phố lên đèn, hoặc trải nghiệm du thuyền trên sông Hàn để có cái nhìn toàn cảnh và trọn vẹn hơn về vẻ đẹp của cây cầu.
Cầu Sông Hàn không chỉ là một công trình kỹ thuật ấn tượng mà còn mang giá trị văn hóa và lịch sử sâu sắc. Nó là minh chứng cho sự kiên cường, sáng tạo của con người Đà Nẵng, đồng thời là biểu tượng cho sự chuyển mình, hội nhập của thành phố biển xinh đẹp này. Đến Đà Nẵng, việc ngắm cầu Sông Hàn xoay đã trở thành một phần không thể thiếu trong hành trình khám phá, để cảm nhận trọn vẹn vẻ đẹp và sức sống của "thành phố của những cây cầu".
textTranslated:
The Han River Bridge, a unique architectural symbol of Da Nang, is not only a transportation structure but also a source of pride for the local people and an attractive tourist destination. Inaugurated in 2000, it is the first and only rotating bridge in Vietnam designed and constructed entirely by Vietnamese engineers and workers, showcasing the city's strong development.

With a length of 487.7m and a width of 12.9m, the Han River Bridge connects two main roads, Le Duan (West bank) and Pham Van Dong (East bank), playing a vital role in connecting transportation, boosting the economy and tourism. The most special feature of the bridge is its ability to rotate 90 degrees around its axis at night, creating a passage for large ships to pass through. The moment the bridge rotates, especially on weekend nights (usually around 11 PM), is a unique experience, attracting many tourists and locals to admire it.

At night, the Han River Bridge is adorned with a dazzling array of lights, creating a magical and romantic scene on the river. Visitors can choose to stroll on the bridge, admiring the city lights, or experience a cruise on the Han River for a more complete and panoramic view of the bridge's beauty.

The Han River Bridge is not only an impressive engineering feat but also holds profound cultural and historical value. It is a testament to the resilience and creativity of the people of Da Nang, and a symbol of the transformation and integration of this beautiful coastal city. Visiting Da Nang and watching the Han River Bridge rotate has become an indispensable part of any exploration, allowing one to fully appreciate the beauty and vibrancy of the "city of bridges."

Ça ne vaut pas les sites thailandais, cambodgiens voire indonésiens de même période et civilisations, mais ça se visite agréablement en 1h sans lire ou écouter les explications.

textTranslated:
Not bad, but really only for fans of ancient ruins.

It's not on par with Thai, Cambodian, or even Indonesian sites from the same period and civilizations, but it's a pleasant visit in an hour without reading or listening to explanations. There's an amazing 15-minute dance performance in one of the buildings. It's quite well done, and yet I'm not a fan. The site is a bit far from Hoi An, about an hour's drive each way. I went by scooter, and the road wasn't very interesting. So, in total, it takes at least 3 hours from Hoi An. The entrance fee is 149,000 IDR + 5,000 IDR for parking. There are refreshment stands all over the site. Bring your own water.

text:
チャンパ王4世紀〜13世紀にかけて築かれた祠堂（しどう）や塔院は、接着剤（モルタルなど）を一切使わずに赤レンガを緊密に積み上げる独自の技法で造られている。インド文化の影響を色濃く受けており、壁面や砂岩にはシヴァ神や神話の神々、アプサラ（天女）の美しい彫刻・レリーフが施されている。
アプサラダンス鑑賞し踊り子と遭遇し記念撮影
textTranslated:
The shrines and stupas built by the Champa kings between the 4th and 13th centuries are constructed using a unique technique of tightly stacking red bricks without the use of any adhesives (such as mortar). Heavily influenced by Indian culture, the walls and sandstone are adorned with beautiful carvings and reliefs of Shiva, mythological gods, and Apsaras (celestial maidens).

Watch an Apsara dance, encounter the dancers, and take commemorative photos.

title: Hoi An Village Experience
text:
تجربة القرية في هوي آن
(Hoi An Village Experience)
هي واحدة من أجمل الأنشطة التي تأخذك بعيداً عن زحمة المدينة القديمة لتستمتع بالحياة الريفية والتقاليد الفيتنامية الأصيلة
ركوب القوارب السلالية الدائرية التقليدية المصنوعة من الخيزران (thuyền thúng) والتي يقودها سكان محليون
لتستمتع و تنسجم بجمال الطبيعة بين أشجار جوز الهند تبحر بين ممرات مائية هادئة لتصل لمشاهدة استعراض دوران القوارب السريع والمثير و شخص يرمي بشباك الصيد التقليدية
التجربة راح تكون جميلة بالأجواء الحلوة أما فصل الصيف حر مررره
حنا ركبناها في شهر يوليو (7)
مررره حر
التجربة ممتعة لكن جو المنطقة في الصيف وقت الظهر ما أنصح فيه
الأوقات من 8ص إلى 8 م
جميع الأيام
في الصباح مرره زحمه
رحنا بعد الظهر تخف الزحمه
أنتبهوا من المحتالين عند البوابة
وادخلوا لداخل بتلاقون أشخاص يبيعون وحاولوا تكاسرونهم لأنهم راح يرفعون الأسعار في البداية طلبت مننا حرمه 300000دونغ على كل شخص تقريباً 42 ريال سعودي
ونزلنا سعر القارب ل 4 أشخاص ب 600000 دونغ
يعني 85 ريال سعودي
خذيناه من غير عصير جوز الهند والأكل
لأنه ماراح يناسبنا
يوجد دورة مياه ( الله يكرم الجميع) لكن مو نظيفة
إذا أستفدت من تعليقي اعمل لايك 🤍
textTranslated:
The Hoi An Village Experience is one of the most beautiful activities that takes you away from the hustle and bustle of the old city to enjoy rural life and authentic Vietnamese traditions. Ride the traditional circular bamboo boats (thuyền thúng) piloted by locals. Enjoy the beauty of nature amidst the coconut trees, sailing through tranquil waterways to witness the exciting and fast-paced boat rotations and someone casting traditional fishing nets. The experience is wonderful in the pleasant weather, but it's extremely hot in the summer. We rode in July, and it was incredibly hot. The experience is enjoyable, but I don't recommend it during the midday heat. The hours are from 8 AM to 8 PM, every day. It's very crowded in the morning, so we went in the afternoon when it was less busy. Beware of scammers at the gate. Once inside, you'll find people selling things; try to haggle because they will raise the prices. Initially, a woman asked us for 300,000 VND per person. Approximately 42 Saudi Riyals.

We reduced the price of the boat for 4 people to 600,000 Dong, which is 85 Saudi Riyals.
We bought it without the coconut juice and food because it wouldn't suit us.
There is a restroom (excuse the expression), but it's not clean.
If you found my review helpful, please like it 🤍
address: Hoi An Dong, Da Nang, Vietnam

title: Quan Thang Ancient House
text:
Ein wunderschönes historisches Haus mitten in der Altstadt von Hội An. Die Nhà cổ Quân Thắng ist ein beeindruckendes Beispiel für die traditionelle Architektur der alten Handelsstadt und zeigt sehr schön die Verbindung verschiedener asiatischer Kulturen. ✨

Besonders faszinierend sind die alten Holzkonstruktionen, die kunstvollen Details und die ruhige Atmosphäre im Inneren. Man bekommt einen tollen Eindruck davon, wie wohlhabende Händler früher in Hội An gelebt und gearbeitet haben. Die Mischung aus chinesischen und vietnamesischen Architekturelementen macht diesen Ort besonders einzigartig.

Ein schöner Ort für alle, die Geschichte, Kultur und traditionelle Architektur lieben. Nicht so überlaufen wie andere Sehenswürdigkeiten und perfekt, um während eines Spaziergangs durch die Altstadt einen Blick in die Vergangenheit von Hội An zu werfen.

Sehr empfehlenswert! 🌿✨
textTranslated:
A beautiful historic house in the heart of Hoi An's Old Town. The Nha Cu Quan Thang is an impressive example of the traditional architecture of this ancient trading city and beautifully showcases the fusion of various Asian cultures. ✨

The old wooden structures, the intricate details, and the tranquil atmosphere inside are particularly captivating. You get a wonderful sense of how wealthy merchants once lived and worked in Hoi An. The blend of Chinese and Vietnamese architectural elements makes this place truly unique.

A wonderful spot for anyone who loves history, culture, and traditional architecture. Not as crowded as other tourist attractions, it's perfect for glimpsing Hoi An's past while strolling through the Old Town.

Highly recommended! 🌿✨

「Quan Thang Ancient House（クアンタンの家）」は、ホイアン旧市街にある歴史的価値の高い古民家の一つ（77 Tr?n Phú（チャン・フー通り）

18世紀（または約150～300年前）に建てられた、中国・広州出身の商人、クアン・タン氏の邸宅。 建築: 熟練の職人によって手作業で彫刻された貴重な木材が使われており、中国様式とベトナム様式が融合した美しい建築として知られている。精巧な木彫り細工や、風水に基づいた中庭の設計などが見どころ
textTranslated:
Quan Thang Ancient House is one of the historically significant old houses in Hoi An's Old Town (77 Trán Phu Street).

Built in the 18th century (or approximately 150-300 years ago), it was the residence of Quan Thang, a merchant from Guangzhou, China. Architecture: Known for its beautiful blend of Chinese and Vietnamese architectural styles, it utilizes precious wood hand-carved by skilled craftsmen. Highlights include the exquisite wood carvings and the courtyard design based on feng shui principles.

text:
Quá nhiều hoạt động để trải nghiệm tại nơi đây, đợt nhà mình đi vào tháng 8 còn có cả Lễ hội bia Sun Fest uống SunKraft Beer xả láng. Mỗi khách còn được phát 1 voucher lúc mới vào cổng để đổi 2 bia hoặc 1 món nhắm nhẹ.

Tất nhiên không thể không kể đến đoạn cáp treo “lướt” quá khu rừng nguyên sơ kỳ vĩ của Bà Nà, quá mãn nhãn.

Nên đi sớm và có mặt ở đây từ 8h sẽ tránh được khách đoàn và đỡ đông. Cáp treo hoạt động từ 8h đến 17h. Từ ngoài cổng đến vào khu cáp cũng kéo khá nhiều, có thể mua vé wow pass 300k/ khách để rút ngắn quãng đường đi bộ.

Giá cả các nhà hàng cũng khá mềm so với địa thế “độc quyền” ở đây.

Bãi đỗ xe gia đình 4-7 chỗ sẽ ở ngoài, sau đó đi shuttle bus lên. Mùa hè dẫn cả gia đình đi chơi là hợp lý nhất. Trong khi người lớn có thể khám phá hầm rượu, làm ly vang ngắm nhìn toàn cảnh Bà Nà thì “người trẻ” có thể chơi các trò chơi mạo hiểm khá kỳ thú.

Thời tiết se se, có nắng nhẹ, ngồi uống ly bia hoặc tách cà phê trên này thì không còn gì bằng.
textTranslated:
There are so many things to experience here. When we went in August, there was even the Sun Fest beer festival where you could drink all the SunKraft Beer you wanted. Each guest also received a voucher upon entry to redeem for two beers or a light snack.

Of course, we can't forget the cable car ride gliding over the magnificent pristine forest of Ba Na Hills – it was breathtaking.

It's best to arrive early, around 8 am, to avoid large groups and crowds. The cable car operates from 8 am to 5 pm. There are quite a few people walking from the entrance to the cable car area; you can buy a Wow Pass for 300k VND per person to shorten the walk.

The prices at the restaurants are also quite reasonable considering the "exclusive" location.

Family parking for 4-7 seater cars is outside, then you take a shuttle bus up. Summer is the best time to visit with the whole family. While adults can explore the wine cellar, enjoy a glass of wine while admiring the panoramic view of Ba Na Hills, younger people can enjoy exciting adventure games.

The weather is cool and sunny; sitting here with a beer or a cup of coffee is simply wonderful.

If there is a slight downside, it is that the breakfast taste is so-so, and since there are only two menu options, there isn't much to eat if you stay for a long time.

title: Naman Retreat
text:
An Even More Wonderful Second Stay at Naman Retreat – Special Thanks to Min!

I first visited Naman Retreat nine years ago and had such wonderful memories that I decided to return, this time with my husband and son. And I’m so happy I did!

What made our second visit even more special was our amazing Personal Ambassador, Min.

When I mentioned that I had stayed here nine years ago, Min surprised us with thoughtful complimentary treats, including wine, cake, and milk, to celebrate our return. It was such a lovely gesture that made us feel truly welcomed and appreciated.

Throughout our stay, Min was incredibly attentive, kind, and efficient. From arranging and rescheduling spa appointments to taking care of every little request, Min was always just a KakaoTalk message away. Whatever we needed, Min handled it quickly and effortlessly. Having someone so reliable and caring made our stay even more relaxing and enjoyable. Min was truly our problem-solver and made us feel completely at ease!

Of course, Naman Retreat itself remains as beautiful as I remembered. I absolutely love its peaceful, nature-inspired atmosphere. It’s the perfect place to escape the busy world, unwind, and recharge.

The dining experiences were also fantastic! We thoroughly enjoyed our delicious dinner at B-Lounge, and the Asian Grill & Hot Pot with live band performances was another highlight of our stay. Great food, beautiful surroundings, and live music made for such memorable evenings.

Nine years later, Naman Retreat still holds a special place in my heart, and this second visit was even more meaningful thanks to Min’s exceptional hospitality.

Thank you so much, Min, for making our family vacation truly unforgettable! We will definitely be back again!

(white angel HAU. I can’t thank you enough for all your help. I really appreciate it. Thank you so much.) 누가 다낭에 온다고 하면 닥치고 여기!! 나만 리트리트 예약하라고 하세요!! 최고의 만족감을 느낄겁니다!! 리조트의 모든 직원들에게 감사드려요^^
textTranslated: I stayed at Babylon for 7 nights. It deserves more than 5 stars—it deserves 100. In terms of facilities, service, scenery, location, and breakfast (you say the variety is limited? Not at all!), I can say it is by far the best resort I have ever visited on an overseas trip. In particular, the dedicated manager's KakaoTalk chat service is truly smart and friendly. From how they handled things and the speed of their response to their kindness... it is a service that makes even the smallest inconvenience feel pleasant. (Thank you, dedicated manager Min!) The location is situated between the city center and Hoi An, so it offers good accessibility to both, and there are shuttle buses for both, allowing you to save on taxi fares. Although some say the breakfast selection is a bit limited, by our standards, it was a satisfying breakfast that we fully enjoyed. There are three pools: the Apartment Pool, the Babylon Pool, and the Main Pool. The Main Pool even has a heated spa.^^ Finally, one thing I can't forget!! Midway through the trip, I was worried because I had cold symptoms (fever, cough, etc.), but there is a resident nurse at the resort. She came over, took my temperature, and prescribed medicine (this is truly insane service). Thanks to her, I recovered quickly and was able to complete the rest of my itinerary without any problems. (White Angel HAU. I can’t thank you enough for all your help. I really appreciate it. Thank you so much.) If anyone says they are coming to Da Nang, tell them to shut up and book this place!! Tell them to book the Retreat exclusively for me!! They will feel the ultimate satisfaction!! Thank you to all the staff at the resort^^

Although it is located away from the city center, we were able to use the Lotte Mart shuttle for free, and we traveled to Hoi An comfortably using the free round-trip shuttle.

Since it is a famous resort, Katie, a personal manager dedicated to Korean guests, took care of us from check-in to check-out. It was so convenient to be able to ask questions via KakaoTalk whenever we had any!

The children were fully satisfied, and seeing them say they want to come back again, it seems it was a trip that everyone was happy with.

text:
2泊3日で利用しました。

滞在中はとても素晴らしい時間を過ごすことができました。プールは広くてとても綺麗で、ヴィラも清潔感があり、快適に過ごせました。

朝食もとても充実していて、野菜をたくさん食べられたのが嬉しかったです。ハムやドレッシングの種類も豊富で、毎朝の朝食を楽しむことができました。

特に素晴らしかったのが、スタッフのMinさんの対応です。チェックインから滞在中までずっとサポートしてくださり、LINEを通じて質問やお願いにもすぐに対応していただけたので、とても助かりました。

ホイアンへ出かけた際には、夕食のお店の予約まで手伝ってくださり、おかげで安心して旅行を楽しむことができました。Minさんの親切で丁寧な対応にとても感謝しています。

ホテルの設備や雰囲気はもちろん、スタッフの方々のサービスも素晴らしく、またダナンを訪れる際にはぜひ利用したいと思います。素敵な時間をありがとうございました！
textTranslated:
I stayed for 2 nights and 3 days.

I had a wonderful time during my stay. The pool was large and very clean, and the villa was clean and comfortable.

The breakfast was also very substantial, and I was happy to be able to eat a lot of vegetables. There was a wide variety of ham and dressings, and I enjoyed breakfast every morning.

What was particularly wonderful was the service from staff member Min. She supported me from check-in to throughout my stay, and responded quickly to my questions and requests via LINE, which was very helpful.

When I went to Hoi An, she even helped me make restaurant reservations for dinner, which allowed me to enjoy my trip with peace of mind. I am very grateful for Min's kind and attentive service.

Not only were the hotel facilities and atmosphere excellent, but the service from the staff was also wonderful, and I would definitely like to stay here again when I visit Da Nang. Thank you for a wonderful time!

text:
부모님과 함께 Naman Retreat에서 정말 편안하고 여유로운 시간을 보내고 왔어요 😊

Three Bedroom Pool Villa에서 지냈는데 객실도 넓고 깔끔하게 관리되어 있어서 가족끼리 머물기에 정말 좋았습니다. 빌라에 있는 프라이빗 풀도 넓고 분위기가 좋아서 머무는 동안 여유롭게 잘 이용했고, 리조트 전체적인 조경과 분위기도 너무 예뻐서 산책하는 것만으로도 힐링되는 느낌이었어요.

무엇보다 부모님도 숙소가 편안하고 조용해서 머무는 동안 불편함 없이 정말 잘 쉬셨다고 하셔서 저도 만족스러웠습니다.

text:
소원배에 대해 완벽하게 리뷰합니다.
일단 소원배는 모터배와 나룻배 두가지가 있음. 둘 다
일정 시간이 되야 판매소(간이)가 나옴. 호객꾼말고 판매소에서 구매하시고,
모터배는 올드시티에서 동편쪽에 모여있고 4~6인이 18만동에 소원등도 1인 1개씩 무료로 줌.
티켓 사서 타고 싶은시간에 해당 판매소로 가서 티켓주고 타면 됨.
모터배보다 더 서쪽으로(위로 가는 느낌방향) 쭉 다리(야시장)까지 올라가다보면 그린색조끼 입은 나룻배 사람들이 보이기 시작하고 판매소도 보임. 여긴 일정시간 (해질 무렵)되면 거의 줄을 서고 있어 바로 알아 볼 수 있고,
4~6인이 22만동이고 소원등은 별도구매임.
소원등 호객꾼 많은데 보통 1개 1만동이고 나이든 할머니 몇분은 2개 1만동에도 판매함.

모터배는 조금 멀리 나가서 소원등 띄우고 돌아오고
나룻배는 옹기종기 모인 나룻배들끼리 모이는데 나룻배는 분위기. 모터배는 시원한 개방감을 느껴서 둘 다 특색은 있음.
해지기 전엔 모터배, 해진 후는 나룻배가 정답임.
첨언하자면 새모양의 날리는 장난감 많이 파는데 절대 사지마셈. 거의 20분안에 고장아니면 부서짐. 그리고 어차피 일반인은 사도 잘 못날림.
textTranslated:
Here's a complete review of the Wish Boat.
First, there are two types of Wish Boats: motorboats and ferryboats.
For both, a temporary booth opens at a certain time. Buy yours at the booth, not the touts.
Motorboats are located east of Old City. Groups of 4-6 people pay 180,000 dong, and each person gets a free wish lantern.
Buy a ticket, then go to the appropriate booth at the time you want to ride, present your ticket, and hop on.
Further west than the motorboats (as if heading upwards), all the way up to the bridge (night market), you'll start to see people carrying boats in green vests, and you'll also see the booth. There's usually a line here around sunset, so you can easily recognize them.
For 4-6 people, the price is 220,000 dong, and the wish lanterns are sold separately.
There are many touts selling wish lanterns, but they usually sell one for 10,000 dong. Some older ladies even sell two for 10,000 dong.

Motorboats sail a little farther out, release wish lanterns, and then return.
Ferry boats gather in groups, each offering a unique atmosphere. Motorboats offer a refreshing sense of openness, so both have their own unique charm.
Before sunset, motorboats are the way to go, and after sunset, ferry boats are the way to go.
As an aside, there are a lot of bird-shaped flying toys for sale, but never buy them. They break or break within 20 minutes. And even if you buy one, most people won't be able to fly it well anyway.

text:
Walked-in for dinner for 2 on Friday around 9pm, waitlist says 25 mins but it was more like 10. We sat outdoors, and hostess offered blankets.
